notes.title: Update 1.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! Street PC Update 1.8.0 is now available! 


What’s New in This Version 

New Features:

- Livery store: This long-awaited feature is now here! Publish your liveries in the store and get rewards for every download.

- Major leaderboard update: Challenge yourself in new ranked leaderboard races! Climb the ranks and earn more valuable rewards.

- Player spectator mode: A new feature for content creators that makes recording easier.



New Content:

- Cars:

1. VPR: Get behind the wheel of an extreme sports car with insane acceleration, precise handling, and a high top speed.

2. M34: Immerse yourself in a classic world, where driving emotions come first.


3. HNG: Hit the track in the most powerful car in the game! Experience its drive and incredible acceleration.

- New effects: New exclusive nitro and backfire effects added. Customize your exhaust system to the max!

- New liveries: Add style to your car with fresh stickers.

- New license plates: Pick a plate that perfectly reflects your style.

- New Turbofans: Complete your car’s look with rare rims.



Improvements:

- 34R headlight model updated.

- Car classes for all leaderboard races reworked.

- Ability to create Speed League races in the mountain area and at Sunset Speedway track added.

- Car ghosts in photo mode now displayed correctly.

- Microphone added to drone camera; you can now hear engine roar during flight.

- Free camera rotation in cockpit view added.

- Global lighting improved.

- Throttle response on wheels and controllers improved..



Car Balance:

- 33R weight increased



Optimization:

- Rendering of other players’ cars in multiplayer rooms optimized.



Fixes:

- Slipstream in leaderboard races fixed.

- Rearview camera behavior fixed.

- UI bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Update announcement
notes.notes:
What's up, drivers! On Friday, the Street PC 1.2.1 update was released, and many of you had questions about why the Sunset Speedway DLC wasn’t included in the Deluxe Edition on Steam. Here’s our response:

You’re absolutely right — on the release date, August 29, 2024, it was planned for the Sunset Speedway DLC to be part of the Deluxe Edition, with the total price of the bundle set at $29,99.

Unfortunately, during the DLC’s launch on Steam, a technical error occurred — the platform did not include Sunset Speedway in the Deluxe Edition and automatically reduced the price of the bundle from $29,99 to $21,68 without notifying us. As a result, the information during the first two hours after release was inaccurate.

Attempts to resolve the issue were unsuccessful, so the Sunset Speedway DLC was removed from the Deluxe Edition description, as it could no longer be included.

We understand that those who purchased the Deluxe Edition within the first two hours of its release, expecting the Sunset Speedway DLC to be included, may feel disappointed. To address this, we are taking matters into our own hands. If you purchased the Deluxe Edition on August 29 between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM (UTC+3), please contact our support team support@carx-tech.com with proof of purchase. We will provide you with a key for the Sunset Speedway DLC.

Please note that distributing the keys may take some time, as the process will be handled manually.

As compensation for the technical error and the incorrect description at the game’s release, 250 gold coins have been added to your Steam accounts.

Let’s go over this again: Steam independently removed the Sunset Speedway DLC from the Deluxe Edition and immediately adjusted the price to $21,68. In other words, at the time of the bundle’s release, the Deluxe Edition no longer included the Sunset Speedway DLC, and the price reflected the contents of the bundle. Within two hours of the release on August 29, 2024, we updated the information in the description. From that point onward, the description on Steam no longer included the Sunset Speedway DLC, as you can see it now.

We apologize for the technical issue at launch and thank you for staying with us. We will continue to develop the game and add exciting new content!

Added Tandem Drift Bonus System. Earn additional rewards in the form of soft currency and experience for Tandem Drifts during free ride.

Localization:

Added Spanish and Portuguese translations.

PC version FAQ
notes.notes:
What's up drivers!

Thanks a lot for all your feedback on CarX Street for PC release date announcement and to follow it up, we'd like to answer some of your most popular questions. 

Will there be cross-progression between mobile and PC versions?

We don't have such plans, but we are looking into our options for providing mobile players with special rewards for purchasing PC version.

How is PC version different from the mobile one?

First, we've completely reworked in-game balance for the PC version of the game: rewards were increased, so players could gain in-game currency the most comfortable way and there are no microtransactions in PC version.   

Graphics will also be better: overall detail and quality, decals and anti-aliasing.

Additionally, the PC version will support not only controllers, but steering wheels as well. We'll share a list of such devices soon.

Will there be cross-play between PC and mobile?

We don't have plans to add this feature. For fair play purpose, PC players won't be able to play with mobile version players.

When should we expect the console version to be released? 

We are working on it and according to our estimates, all base work will be done by the end of the year.

notes.title: CarX Street PC Version News
notes.notes:
What's up drivers!

It's been a while since we shared any CarX Street PC version news and today finally the time has come to fix that.

1. CarX Street will be coming to Steam Early Access this year. Early access means, that we'll be developing and improving our game for some time before the official release happens.

2. At the end of the past year, we had our first ever closed beta-test of the project, and we have plans to conduct another one before the official release.

3. Based on closed beta test feedback, we've compiled a list of bugs and various improvements that needs to be fixed and implemented in our game.

According to our rough estimates, we'll need 2-3 months to finish all the necessary work and after that we'll organize another round of closed beta test which will be a sort of final test before Early Access release.

Once again, we'd like to point out that game development is a "live" process and some unforeseen circumstances are possible to happen and affect development process, so we are not ready yet to announce any specific date for Early Access or final release.

But we'd like to assure you, that we'll keep you informed about the development process, and we'll be back with the news as soon as we have something to share.

Thanks a lot for your support.

[previewyoutube=Km2eMOQfm7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Why release date is change
notes.notes:
Why release date is change ?

Dear players. We seriously underestimated the amount of work at the start of the project, so we are forced to change the release date from November 5, 2020 to November 24, 2021. As always, we try to do the best for our fans, and we are obliged to reach a whole new level of quality of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35655900/145129824eddfae5f9657f756057412d5c1f78b2.png

The current work plan allows us to say with confidence that the selected date is more correct.

During the next year, we will actively inform you about our project development process.

Sincerely, CarX Street team.
